lines.text: Jay Shetty, a global bestselling author, award-winning podcast host of On Purpose, and…
You may not have chosen where you are, but you do get to choose whether you stay there ❤️
Everyone has something going on in their life, be kind ❤️
Don’t give one bad moment more time than it deserves 🤍 Love this trend going around. If you know the original creator let me know 🙏

@mikaylajmakeup OUT NOW 🎙️ Comment “YES” and I’ll send the episode right to your DM’s👇 Watch on Netflix, Spotify and audio everywhere you get your podcasts | If you know anything about Mikayla, you won’t want to miss this.

EXCLUSIVE: Leave a “YES” below and I’ll DM you the full episode👇 @mikaylajmakeup opens up like never before on On Purpose 🎙️ For the first time, Mikayla opens up about what really happened behind the end of her marriage, the realities of loving someone through addiction, and the role she believes her own career and choices played in their relationship falling apart. We also talk about the side of success no one sees: going from losing everything during COVID to becoming one of the biggest beauty creators in the world, dealing with overwhelming online hate, struggling with depression and self-esteem, and learning how to separate who she is from what millions of people say about her online. What I appreciated most about this conversation was Mikayla’s willingness to take us beyond the version of her we see on social media. She doesn’t shy away from the difficult parts of her story or from taking accountability for the things she wishes she’d done differently. If you’ve ever struggled with your self-worth, lost yourself in your career, loved someone through addiction, gone through the end of a relationship, or had to figure out who you are after a chapter of your life didn’t go the way you imagined… this conversation will stay with you. 🎧 Video available on Netflix or Spotify by searching “On Purpose with Mikayla Nogueira” or listen wherever you get your podcasts // LINK IN BIO
Let's all be a little more concerned about this 🙏
This is so important... don't beat yourself up ❤️
Let's heal so we can stop this ❤️
